NewsArticle.Title: Maintenance
NewsArticle.Content: 11:50 - 11:59 a.m., Dark Ages was offline for scheduled maintenance and internal structure upgrades. Please report abnormal software behavior: [www.darkages.com/contact](http://www.darkages.com/contact) Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
